lines: Funeral program service page for George William Thompson, Jr., age 71: August 24, 1950 - June 20, 2022. Funeral service Monday, June 27, 2022 (the program prints 'Monday, 27, 2022' without the month; June 27, 2022 was a Monday), 10:00 A.M., Watson Funeral Home, Millsboro, Delaware; officiating Rev. Tambara Stewart; interment Old Field Cemetery, Millsboro, Delaware. Program page photographed and supplied by Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23.
